capabilities: Run configured local scripts as child processes with prompted parameters
Discover and download scripts from a configurable JSON catalog
Track installed script versions and surface available updates
Substitute template variables for vault paths, Downloads files, and the active file
Create and manage Python virtual environments for scripts
extras: Desktop-only. Runs local scripts with your full user permissions, which can read, write, and delete files outside the vault; the README includes extensive security and trust-model warnings. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Network use is limited to fetching the catalog and downloading scripts you choose.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to launch configured local scripts with parameters from the command palette.

relations.evidence: launches local executables and scripts (for example Python) as child processes

requires.name: Python (for scripts using the virtual environment feature)

summary: Desktop-only plugin that discovers, downloads, and runs local scripts from a JSON catalog with prompted parameters and template variables.
